ns2:section.sectionText: FA22 - ENGL 350 Disney, Identity, and Feminism: A Whole New World What might we observe by viewing Disney films through a feminist lens? From Cinderella to Moana, we will read and apply feminist concepts to analyze the power and influence of Disney’s most popular heroines. We will adopt a focused lens to analyze each film, such as: sex, gender, sexuality, race, nationality, class, disability, body size, age, etc. By applying a feminist lens, we will expand and strengthen our analytical skills to track patterns of representation and engagement across the global franchise. If you enroll in this class, you should feel willing to critically interrogate some of your favorite and most nostalgic movies. Otherwise, come as you are -- no previous knowledge or experience is required.
